lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ag3CuP (Ag18Cu6P6 per cell) is tetragonal, space group I4_1/amd (No. 143), with 30 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Ag centers with 11 neighbors (Ag, Cu, and P), Cu centers with 8 neighbors (Ag and P), and P centers with 9 neighbors (Ag and Cu). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3D connected component. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner, edge, and face sharing between Ag 11-vertex and P 9-vertex polyhedra, as well as corner sharing between Ag and Cu 8-vertex polyhedra.
